title: Alam ke Saaye me Kehte chalo hussain
body:
alam ke saaye mein kehte chalo hussain hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
1. lahoo badan mein hai jab tak kaho hussain hussain
zameen-e-fikr pey likte raho hussain hussain
zabaan -e- ashq se awaaz do hussain hussain
<<MINI>>
alam ke saaye mein kehte chalo hussain hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
2. jab aaye qaimo mein beton ki lash khoon mein tar
khushi se bhai se kehti thi zainab-e-muztar
mere pisar huwe tujh par fida hussain hussain
<<MINI>>
alam ke saye mein . . .
<<DIVIDER>>
3. wo dasht zulm wo gurbat wo shay ki tanhayi
jawaan betey ke gham se gayi hai benaayi
ghareeb -o- bekas-o- be aasra hussain hussain
<<MINI>>
alam ke saaye mein . . .
<<DIVIDER>>
4. kisi ne dekhi hai aisi kahin koi shaadi
jaha pe dulha bhi pyasa dulhan bhi hai pyaasi
hai ghar mein shaadi ke aaho buka hussain hussain
<<MINI>>
alam ke saaye mein . . .
<<DIVIDER>>
5. na jaane fatima kubra ke dil pe kya guzri
jaha pe hone the kangan waha pe hai rassi
dulhan ke sar pe nahi hai rida hussain hussain
<<MINI>>
alam ke saaye mein . . .
<<DIVIDER>>
6. na chand lamho mein aisi kisi ki maang ujdey
dulhan ke aage hai dulha ke laash ke tukdey
sambhalo kubra ko aakar zara hussain
<<MINI>>
hussain alam ke saaye mein . . .
<<DIVIDER>>
7. huwa hamara badan zakhmi taaziyano se
lahoo tapakta hai baba hamarey kaano se
jala huwa hai ye kurta mera hussain hussain
<<MINI>>
alam ke saaye mein . . .
<<DIVIDER>>
8. kaha sakina ne main aah bhar nahi sakti
gale mein rassi hai main baat kar nahi sakti
pukaro kaise kise doon sada hussain hussain
<<MINI>>
alam ke saaye mein . . .
<<DIVIDER>>
9. karengey shey ke alamdaar hum ter matam
buland rakhengey abbas hum tera parcham
sahara dejo shah e karbala hussain hussain
<<MINI>>
alam ke saaye mein . . .
